defs.def: to say hello to sb or to welcome them 和（某人）打招呼（或问好）；欢迎；迎接

ex.s: Every day he would greet me with cheer, “Good morning, Caroline.
ex.t: 每天他都会愉快地问候我，"早上好，Caroline。

ex.s: A simple greeting in their mother tongue can guarantee a smile from a total stranger and a tired traveller.
ex.t: 用他们的母语简单问候一句，就能让一个完全陌生的人和疲惫的旅客露出微笑。

ex.s: As your boat edges out into the blue water, a group of dolphins come to greet you and swim around the boat, jumping playfully around you.
ex.t: 当你的小船缓缓驶入蓝色水域时，一群海豚来迎接你，在你周围游来游去，欢快地跳跃。

ex.s: Best wishes, Write the date and greet the reader.
ex.t: 最好的祝福。写上日期并问候读者。

ex.s: On a quiet morning in the mountains, feel the sun on your skin, and breathe in the sweet scent of fresh flowers while birds greet the new day with their morning song.
ex.t: 在山中宁静的早晨，感受阳光照在皮肤上，呼吸鲜花的甜美香气，而鸟儿用它们的晨歌迎接新的一天。

defs.def: to react to sb/sth in a particular way （以某种方式）对 … 作出反应
to be the first thing that you see, hear or smell at a particular time 景象、声音或气味

ex.s: All the best, Date Greeting Close Body Signature 3 Use what you have learnt to write a letter of advice to one of the teenagers below.
ex.t: 一切顺利。日期、问候、正文、落款、签名。用你学到的内容写一封建议信给下面的一位青少年。

ex.s: On their first trip out, they were greeted with such enthusiasm from the 10 families who’d already established homes there that they decided to join.
ex.t: 第一次实地探访时，已在那里安家的10户人家热情相迎，这让他们决定加入。

ex.s: Stamp → 16 May Hi, Emma, ← Greeting I’m having a really great time in Yunnan, China!
ex.t: 邮票：5月16日。嗨，艾玛，问候。我在中国云南玩得很开心！
